purpose: Provide independently exercisable fail-closed controls for DEV03 successor generation, transfer, private promotion and Archive-v6 persistence.

activation_policy.rule: All four controls remain false until the I03 parent-binding infrastructure and PREP07 resource instrumentation are validated.

hard_breach_behavior: Do not advance the affected successor latest/promotion pointer.
Disable the affected shadow stage when safe to do so.
Do not mutate or disable operational v2/v5/v16.
Require an explicit FIX or versioned budget/design change before re-enablement.

network_boundary.wp03_i04_precondition: WP03-I03 PASS and daily/network retry budgets have remaining capacity
